attempts.summary: Deployed a 4-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1-node4) on RHEL 9.8. Bootstrapped node1, joined node2 and node3 via rsync SST to form the initial 3-node cluster with an application database (appdb.orders), then added node4 by updating all nodes' gcomm address lists and starting it - node4 received the full existing dataset via SST and successfully accepted a new write that replicated to all other members. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all 4 nodes (node2, node3, node4, node1 in that order), each restart preserving quorum with the other 3 members, verified via changed OS boot_id and full Galera re-sync (wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced state, data intact) after each restart.
